column1: # uq80_manifest.tsv - UQ-80 field manifest: one row per field (or pad span) of each battle_pack.bin table.
# status: page  = meaning stated on an existing DB page (source = page path under Database/FFXII TZA/)
#         pass  = meaning derived in the UQ-80 pass (source = PASS); evidence says what supports it
#         pad   = constant on every shipped row and no reader found; the script re-verifies constancy (value in 'meaning' as const=0xNN)
#         shape = values tallied, reader known or not, no meaning established -> counted in the residue
# Bytes not covered by any row are also residue ("unlisted").
# readers: instruction addresses whose memory operand is this field; ADDR = disp equals the field offset and size equals the
#          field width; ADDR@D = disp D; ADDR:wN = operand size N; both may combine (ADDR@0:w2). The script decodes each one.
# Page keys are expanded by the script (see PAGES in uq80_coverage.py).
